### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/organizations`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (literal, 55 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **9** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `42fe08d0d0512ed27b0e0db99fd9273f59704287` — the merge of head `e2f88e491f5d54477f851b35e7a739c553e8bea2` into base `27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 42fe08d0d0512ed27b0e0db99fd9273f59704287 && git checkout 42fe08d0d0512ed27b0e0db99fd9273f59704287
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b e2f88e491f5d54477f851b35e7a739c553e8bea2 && git checkout -B drift-repro 27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b && git merge --no-ff e2f88e491f5d54477f851b35e7a739c553e8bea2

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 27c0b206ebffe206bfc8bc2426d00fe2ddb28d7b` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · PR #34415 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T15:16Z
Head-sha: `803cc5011855dafb4beba05aafec9e24d590a85f`

**L1 · REWORK(2 项,都是文字,不动代码)** · area o1-E 定稿评论 6920396090 所钉 head。merge-base `cfcba539`,2 个提交,4 个文件。

**已核、无问题的部分**
- PR 形态:`Fixes #34038`,单卡。卡的要求是先测量再决定,PR 给出了 main 上的写入顺序,并选了"等创建者的成员行写入后再回放"。surface 修订 6919848985 说明了落点为何在 `packages/plugins/organizations`;PR-body guards 为绿。
- 代码:Middleware B 只在组织 insert 带 `attributedUserId` 时等待。全仓直接 insert `sys_organization` 的非测试路径只有 Default Organization bootstrap(`ensure-default-organization.ts:590`),它用 `{ isSystem: true }`,不带 attribution,所以照旧在 insert 时回放。SCIM 请求内的 attribution 是 service principal,不带 `attributedUserId`。等待项在回放前删除,所以每个组织只回放一次。founder 的取值与 main 相同:先取 `attributedUserId`,再取 `userId`。
- 测试:wall 测试真实启动(`bootStack`、isolated posture、真实 AuthPlugin 与 AppPlugin replayer),组织经 `POST /auth/organization/create` 创建。断言三种人员引用都存成 founder 的 id;非成员的对照仍为 NULL;前提用例确认 wall 已立起、成员只有 founder。PR 正文给了 main 上为红、修复后为绿、撤掉修复后再变红的读数。单元测试 pin 住三点:等的是本组织的第一条成员行;别的组织的成员行不放行;第二个成员不再回放。本 PR 不涉及拒收,不欠 code/status 断言。
- 文档:`content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` 的"按成员关系解析 `sys_user`"表与本改动一致,没有句子要改。
- 门禁:本 head 共 50 条 check-runs,全部 `success` 或 `skipped`,包括 Test Core 1–7 与聚合 job、Lint & Repo Gates 及其分片、TypeScript Type Check 及其分片、Check Changeset、Governed Surface Queue Guard。UI 与 Build Docs 是 skipped,因为本 PR 没有改到相应路径。
- 标题不带 `!`,没有 narrowing arm,不欠 battery。

**R1 · changeset 中的分类比代码宽。** 第 3 段写"The per-organization replay now waits, for an organization better-auth creates…"。代码判断的依据是 insert 带不带 `attributedUserId`,也就是是否有已登录的人发起请求,而不是"是不是 better-auth 建的"。PR 正文的 Acceptance notes 自己也写了:不在 auth 请求内的服务端 `auth.api.createOrganization({ body: { userId } })` 同样由 better-auth 建组织,却仍在 insert 时回放。同段末句"Organizations created any other way … replay on the insert"列举的例子里也没有这一类。请把这句改成按代码的判据来写,例如"for an organization a signed-in person creates (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create`)",并把这条服务端调用放进"any other way"一句。

**R2 · 范围外事项缺去处。** Acceptance notes 的"Not measured"一条写到:walled 部署下 Default Organization bootstrap 也在 insert 时回放,早于绑定平台 owner,所以 seed 中指向 owner 的 `Field.user()` 列会留空。这是同一类缺陷换了一条路径,不能只写"本 PR 不测量"。请二选一:给它一张卡(#N),或者写明一条可核对的理由说明它不是缺陷(例如该路径在 walled 下不回放、不会出现这类列)。另一条 residual(服务端无请求调用)已写明理由,即仓内没有这种调用方,保留即可。

非阻塞:`organizations-plugin.ts` 的注释写"better-auth's writes are the only ones that carry `attributedUserId`"。仓内还有别的写入方也带这个键(metadata 仓、own-row delete、adopt-membership 等),只是它们都不 insert `sys_organization`。可以收窄成"the only `sys_organization` insert that carries it"。改不改由区线程定,不影响本核对。

落地条款:非受管路径,area 已声明 Clause-② no、Metadata-protocol none、不欠 L2。R1、R2 收口后,把 delta 发我即可;我只读 delta,并核新 head 的 check。

## 席位核对 · PR #34415 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T17:00Z
Head-sha: `e2f88e491f5d54477f851b35e7a739c553e8bea2`

**L1 delta · ACCEPT** · 对照 L1 REWORK 6920473642(@ `803cc501`)。只读 delta:`803cc501..e2f88e49`,1 个提交,只改文字(changeset 1 行、注释 4 行),merge-base 未变(`cfcba539`)。

- **R1 已收口**:changeset 第 3 段的判据改为「an organization a signed-in person creates (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create`, whose `sys_organization` insert carries that person as `attributedUserId`)」,与代码的判断条件一致。没有 auth 请求在作用域内的服务端 `auth.api.createOrganization` 调用已列进「any other way」一句,与 PR 正文的 residual 一致。
- **R2 已收口**:PR 正文的 Acceptance notes 改为「Out of scope, filed as #34425」,并附上在 walled `bootStack` 上的实测(dev 报告 6923080865):`Field.user()` 列为 NULL;`owner_id` 之所以读到 owner,只是靠后续的 handoff。#34425 为 open,标题就是这一缺陷。
- 非阻塞的注释也一并收窄为「the only `sys_organization` insert that carries `attributedUserId`」。只改注释,不改逻辑,测试不受影响。
- 门禁:本 head 读到 54 条 check-runs,35 条 `success`、18 条 `skipped`,没有失败;Check Changeset 在本核对时为 `in_progress`。入队前由区线程确认它为绿;读数不对应本 head 的,不算数。
- 标题不带 `!`,没有 narrowing arm,不欠 battery。

落地条款:非受管路径,Clause-② no,不欠 L2,由区线程落地。
